headline: Revenue jumps while operating profit is nearly flat
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 650.1B (+26.7% y/y) and operating profit KRW 95.7B (+2.2% y/y); EPS was KRW 727, down 59.1% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 727 fell 60.7% q/q and 59.1% y/y. Preliminary figures put revenue at KRW 650.1B, up 12.0% q/q, and operating profit at KRW 95.7B, down 1.9% q/q. One report puts net profit at KRW 32.6B, down 59.1%, and notes one-off M&A costs. Guidance is not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures are preliminary and from AI-translated Korean press and aggregators. EPS is Yahoo data.
